first: From the next native wave after season 9, for any plateau challenge or wave at season 15 and later.
registration: Frozen during season 9's first panel, before any pilot or later promotion openings.
population: Add 80 generations of descendants of the actual champion, using mixed-clock fight outcomes and HP. Scout up to four distinct responses including overall leader, direct leader, clock-and-latency worst-case direct leader, and strongest close descendant.
pilot: One fresh opening per RTT, both seats, champion opponent. Retain W-tap and incumbent controls. Rank by Java fight score, then HP margin. Use this panel exclusively for nomination.
promotion: Carry the pilot winner alongside both original nominees to the ordinary-Java promotion panel on new opening seeds; final challenge always uses two fresh panels. The pilot games do not count for promotion or confirmation.
final_rechallenge: Score the whole archived pool for the final nomination. Any prior credible ordinary-Java counter to the still-current champion also enters the final test and opposing field, even if its simulator ranking falls.
standing_opponents: Keep the original Java champion and retreating rival as reference opponents after the first promotion, along with the current champion. Deduplicate identical weights.
followup_to_native_counter: If an independently tested counter still beats the current Java champion and falls short across the field, give its opponents 12 extra training slots alongside the ordinary 38-slot generalist field. Also nominate a response by the worst of its matchups against the actual champion and verified counter(s), and test it against them in Java. No action or technique enters the objective.
